title: Boulderfist Hall
wikitext:
[[Image:Boulderfist Hall.jpg|thumb|Boulderfist Hall]]
[[Boulderfist Hall]] is a fortress of the [[Boulderfist]] [[ogre]]s in southern [[Arathi Highlands]], near [[Thandol Span]] and [[Witherbark Village]]. The caves are strongly fortified, and inside the larger cave you can find chief [[Kor'gresh Coldrage]].
